logo.name: Brand
logo.help: The supermarket name uses your Shopify store name unless you type an override.

colors.name: Colors
colors.gradient_info: Replaces the solid background when set.

social.name: Social links
social.help: Leave these blank. Links appear only after you add a real URL.

header.name: Header
header.menu_info: Use a menu named Departments. Parent links are departments and child links are subcategory collections. Until that menu has links, the fallback blocks are shown.

hero.name: Hero
hero.image_info: Optional. An illustration is shown when no image is selected.

aisles.name: Department aisles
aisles.help: Reorder department blocks to change the floor order. Keep the same order in the Departments menu.

rail.name: Featured products
rail.help: This row is hidden on the storefront when the collection is empty or not selected.

collection.name: Collection
collection.menu_info: Used for breadcrumbs. Parent links should be departments.

page.name: Page
page.body_info: Shown only when the page body in Admin is empty.

department.name: Department
department.title: Title
department.handle_info: Kebab-case handle. The theme links to the collections path plus this handle, including before that collection exists.

aisle.name: Subcategory
aisle.title: Title
aisle.handle_info: Kebab-case handle. The link is shown even if the collection has not been created yet.
aisle.distinct_info: Use this for Sports nutrition so it stays separate from meat, fish, eggs, and other protein foods.
